title: Save an etcd Snapshot
prompt:
The control plane runs a stacked etcd with certificates under `/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Save an etcd snapshot to `/opt/backup/etcd.db` on `controlplane` using the existing etcd certificates.
2. Do not modify any existing etcd data.

checks.description: Snapshot file `/opt/backup/etcd.db` exists and is non-empty
checks.failure_hint: Run etcdctl snapshot save with the certs under /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/.
The snapshot file is missing or empty.

reference_solution:
Take the snapshot with the etcd certificates.
```bash
sudo ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \
  --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
  --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
  --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key \
  snapshot save /opt/backup/etcd.db
```
hints: SSH to controlplane and verify etcd client flags in /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml.
Pass --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 plus --cacert, --cert, and --key from /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ to etcdctl snapshot save.
